funding.raw: ACP was down and every ACP-bound repository failed closed.

admission.agent_reason: Owner zachshallbetter reports a production outage: redeploying main removed api/index.py so /health and /ready returned 404 and ACP failed closed. Bounded engineering recovery: land the Vercel runtime and add a pre-promotion health check. Repo merges outside work (12 merged PRs); no open PR references #39; issue open and updated today. Code evidence is api/index.py at its current blob SHA, with a line quoted from the file. Unpriced repository-owner request.
admission.scope_quote: Add a pre-promotion check that a production candidate serves `/health` and `/ready` (status ready, storage postgres) on its own deployment URL before it may take the alias.
